subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): re-export StatusSummary, SessionStatus, and HeartbeatStatus from command-status

question: Should plugins receive the complete transitive host `StatusSummary`, `SessionStatus`, and `HeartbeatStatus` shapes as supported public API, or a narrower self-contained status DTO?
rationale: The scoped Plugin SDK policy requires intentional promotion of internal types, and the proposed aliases carry nested contracts owned by several core areas; source inspection cannot determine the long-term compatibility burden maintainers intend to accept.

options.title: Publish self-contained DTOs
options.body: Expose only fields and nested types that OpenClaw intends to support durably for third-party plugins.

options.title: Approve the full host graph
options.body: Accept all three complete aliases and their transitive declaration dependencies as supported public Plugin SDK API.

options.title: Defer to gateway API design
options.body: Pause this PR until the unresolved safe plugin gateway-access surface defines its canonical response contract.

recommendation.title: Publish self-contained DTOs
recommendation.body: Expose only fields and nested types that OpenClaw intends to support durably for third-party plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows direct merger involvement in the exact SDK seam plus recent integration work across both central files, making this the strongest available routing signal for a public-contract decision.
